PrivacyPage.title: Privacy
PrivacyPage.lead: Kallar Central Sports Club runs this website. This policy explains what personal information we collect, why we collect it, and what we do with it. We do not buy personal information, and we do not sell it.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect personal information in four situations.

items.label: Club membership applications.
items.text: When you apply or renew through the Join The Club form, we collect your name, date of birth, gender, phone and WhatsApp numbers, email address, home address, occupation, National Identity Card number (required from age 16), a photograph, guardian details where the applicant is a minor, and the bank payment slip you upload as proof of the annual fee.

items.label: Free tuition programme.
items.text: For children enrolled in our free Grade 3–5 scholarship classes, club staff record the student's name, school, address, grade, photograph, guardian's name and phone number, class attendance and exam marks. This is given to staff in person at enrolment — it is not collected through this website.

items.label: Exam results lookup.
items.text: When you use the Results page, we receive the registration number you type in so we can return that student's published marks.

items.label: Staff accounts.
items.text: Club staff who use the admin console have an account holding their email address and role.

sections.title: How we use it

items.text: Reviewing and approving membership applications, and issuing membership cards.
Verifying annual fee payments made by bank transfer.
Running the tuition programme — attendance registers, exam results, and alerting a guardian when a child has missed classes.
Showing exam results on the Results page, for exams the club has chosen to publish.
Emailing an approved member their membership card.

sections.footnote: We do not use any of this information for advertising, and we do not share it with advertisers.

sections.title: Cookies and advertising
paragraphs: A cookie is a small file stored by your browser. This site uses them in two unrelated ways.

Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve advertising on this site. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to this and other websites. Other third-party advertisers may also place cookies through this site; we do not control those cookies. You can opt out of personalised advertising using the links below.

Separately, when a member of club staff signs in to the admin console, we set a single sign-in cookie so their session stays active. That cookie is not used for advertising or tracking, and it is never set for ordinary visitors.

links.label: Opt out of personalised Google ads
Opt out of other vendors at aboutads.info

sections.footnote: Most browsers also let you block or delete cookies. Blocking them will not stop you using this site.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We use the following service providers to run this site. They handle information on our behalf:

items.label: DigitalOcean Spaces
items.text: — storage for photographs, payment slips and gallery images.

sections.footnote: We do not sell personal information. We disclose it otherwise only where the law requires us to.

sections.title: Children's privacy
paragraphs: The free tuition programme is for children in Grades 3 to 5. We collect their information from a parent or guardian at enrolment, and use it only to run the programme.

Please note that the Results page shows a student's name, grade, marks and class position to anyone who enters that student's registration number, and no other detail is required to see them. Only exams the club has chosen to publish appear there. If you are a parent or guardian and you would prefer your child's results not to be shown that way, contact us and we will remove them.
We do not knowingly allow children to submit information to us directly through this website.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Membership records are kept while a membership is active and afterwards as part of the club's own records. Student records are kept for the duration of the programme and the club's records. A payment slip is deleted once a renewal supersedes it.

items.text: You can ask to see, correct, or delete the information we hold about you or your child. We may need to confirm who you are before acting on a request.
You can opt out of personalised advertising using the links in the section above.
You can ask us to remove your child's results from the public Results page.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Information is held on managed hosting services, reachable only through club staff accounts. Staff sign in with a password, and each role sees only what it needs — tuition-programme staff cannot see membership records at all. No system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date at the top of the page shows when it last changed.

AboutPage.title: Kallar Central
AboutPage.description: The first hard-ball cricket club established in the Kaluwanchikudy region.
AboutPage.journey_body:
Kallar Central Sports Club proudly holds a special place in the cricketing history of the Kaluwanchikudy region as the first hard-ball cricket club established in the area.

The club was founded in 2007 with just 12 members. From those humble beginnings, we have grown into a strong and united sporting organization with more than 170 members today.

More than 50 of our members are currently living in different countries around the world, while continuing to maintain a strong connection with and support for the club.
AboutPage.achievements_body:
Since 2009, Kallar Central Sports Club has been continuously participating in the A Division cricket tournaments organized by the Batticaloa District Cricket Association.

One of our proudest achievements was winning the B Division Champion Cup after defeating Kooddamunai Sports Club in the B Division final organized by the Batticaloa District Cricket Association.

In addition, our club has secured more than eight 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place trophies across various T20 and ODI tournaments, reflecting our players' dedication, teamwork, and competitive spirit.
AboutPage.battleEverest_body:
For the past 11 years, our club has played an important role in organizing the prestigious "Battle of the Everest" Big Match between BT/PD/Periyakallar Central College and BT/Batticaloa Hindu College.

We are also committed to developing young cricketing talent. Our club members have contributed as coaches and mentors, providing training, guidance, and encouragement to young players and helping them develop their skills and confidence.
AboutPage.league_body: Our club actively participates in various cricket leagues and tournaments, providing our players with valuable opportunities to gain experience, improve their skills, and compete at higher levels.
AboutPage.community_body:
Kallar Central Sports Club is committed not only to sporting excellence but also to the well-being and development of our community.

As part of our Annual Club Day, we organize an annual Blood Donation Camp in our village. Through the participation of our club members and the local community, we contribute towards saving lives and supporting those in need.
AboutPage.annualDay_body:
Every year, we proudly organize our Annual Day Function, where we recognize and encourage students who have achieved success in their education — including Grade 05 Scholarship Examination achievers, G.C.E. O/L Examination achievers, and students who gain university admission.

Through these initiatives, we appreciate their achievements and encourage the younger generation to pursue their educational goals.
AboutPage.dengue_body:
Every year, our club members come together to conduct Dengue Prevention Shramadana Campaigns in our village.

We identify and clean areas where water can accumulate, helping to reduce the risk of dengue and promoting a cleaner, healthier, and safer community.
AboutPage.freeEducation_body:
As part of our commitment to education, we provide free tuition classes for Grade 05 Scholarship Examination students.

Through these classes, we aim to provide additional educational support and guidance to students and help them prepare confidently for their examinations, regardless of their financial background.
AboutPage.vision_body:
Our vision is to build unity through sport, nurture the talents of the younger generation, and strengthen our community through education, health, and social responsibility.

We believe that a sports club is not only a place to create talented athletes, but also a platform to create educated, responsible, united, and socially conscious future generations.
AboutPage.closing: More Than a Club — A Community, A Legacy, A Future.
